text:
noah (AE): quick POC Q from LedgerOne — they want tenant pinned to EU, BYOK for keys, but allow failover to APAC only for <5min events. asking for a capped egress credit and explicit subprocessor list if failover occurs.

emma (SE): active-passive ok? we can do affinity + cold failover. BYOK means Dedicated/Private for key control. hosted fallback will touch APAC partners.

noah (AE): active-passive is fine. they want max 2 automatic failovers/month and an audit delivered to their S3.

raj (Infra): hosted fallback order: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-southeast-1. public APAC uses partner "asia-ops-1" and log delivery via "logpipe-ap". we can emit signed route-change events to their S3. BYOK requires Dedicated or Private to avoid partner compute in APAC.

omar (Sales Eng): pricing options: (1) EU reserved pool (reduces failover risk), (2) reserved + small APAC standby, (3) hosted + monthly egress credit cap. example starting point: reserved pool + 500/month egress credit (2TB) as a negotiable line. Dedicated pricing is separate.

lucy (Legal): we can draft an SLA exception referencing counting rules and the egress credit cap. need clear failover counting metric (how we define an incident) and confirmation they want credits (not invoiced egress). also need subprocessors list disclosure timing.

emma (SE): counting rule suggestion: an incident counts if >50% of tenant requests in any 60s window are served from fallback and duration >30s. we'll log request ids + region.

lucy (Legal): good. i'll draft exception: max 2 failovers/month, each <5min to qualify, egress credit capped monthly, audit exports to customer S3 within 24h, subproc attestation within 5 business days.

infra-bot: stress-test: EU pool reached 93% at 2026-08-07T10:03:12Z, fallback to ap-southeast-1 simulated for 38s. logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/tests/1759999999.log :white_check_mark:

noah (AE): perfect. Omar  please prepare the two quote options and i'll loop in the buyer once Legal draft is ready. thanks team.
